The question

Is everyone flying toward the same star?

Each bird is a team or person. The North Star is the company vision. A tight flock means the documents, the work and people’s understanding agree.

North Star · Vision
AlignedSevere gap

Decision Stack

Organised on Martin Eriksson’s Decision Stack. Each tier is read three ways: what the documents say, what the work and data show, and what people report understanding. Gaps between them are flagged, not resolved. Owners can approve changes; decision makers answer open questions.

Work and outcomes

Every initiative should serve at least one objective. The roadmap puts each objective on top, with research, discovery and delivery below it, following Itamar Gilad’s outcome roadmap template. Switch to team view to see who is working on what.

Sample effort figures in FTE; sources S3, S8

Open questions

Questions the evidence raises that the organisation has not answered. Each has a named decision maker. Answers go to the approval queue before they change the record.

Pending changes

Suggested corrections and answers wait here for the owner of the affected item.

Knowledge base

Everything the page is built from. Folders are rescanned on a schedule; uploads are added immediately and tagged by type.
